label: [LOCAL-MECHANISM-PROTOTYPE · NOT EVIDENCE · NOT E2/E3 · NOT a full font · NOT a variable-font-axis claim]
scope: Two MANUALLY DEFINED simple glyph masks (A and H) on a fixed coordinate grid, drawn with ONE dot/primitive family (filled circles) at THREE density/size settings, plus ONE deliberately bad grid case. This is a self-authored geometry toy, NOT a typeface, NOT language coverage, NOT proof the artist used or did not use a variable font axis.

glyph_masks.note: Each [col,row] is an ON grid cell (1 = primitive placed). Manually declared bitmaps, no font file parsed.

grid.note: 5 cols x 16px = 80px glyph width; 7 rows x 16px = 112px glyph height; two glyphs side by side inside 220x140 canvas.

primitive_family.name: filled_circle_dot
primitive_family.description: One primitive family: a filled circle of radius r centered in each ON cell. Three settings vary ONLY r (dot size / density-of-ink). No other primitive family is introduced.

bad_case.description: DELIBERATELY BAD control: shift ONE glyph's primitives by a half-cell offset (8px) AND mix in an UNREGISTERED radius (r=9). This must be detected by the in-bounds/uniform-scale check as a specific, named failure, NOT silently accepted.
bad_case.expected_failure: primitives no longer centered on declared grid cells; radius not in the registered settings; check must report out_of_grid + unregistered_scale

small_size_limitation.description: S11-B calibrated: emit a downscaled cell_px=4 (quarter) render of the SAME A/H geometry and RETAIN the 35 declared primitives. Connectivity / counter (enclosed-hole) topology and readability are NOT measured by this fixture; the small-size case must NOT be described as demonstrating connectivity/counter loss or an 'A hole collapses'. Topology-readability loss stays UNMEASURED / pending_human.
small_size_limitation.expected: small-size render EMITTED at 4px cells / r=1 with 35 primitives retained; C4 checks ONLY n_primitives == 35. No connectivity/counter/readability claim; those remain unmeasured / pending_human.

svg_note: Both SVG and PNG are produced: SVG from stdlib string generation, PNG via Pillow drawing the SAME primitives. Both are checked for identical primitive coordinate/count/bounds ledgers.
intended_checks_before_run: C1 primitive ledger: for each of 3 settings, count of primitives == number of ON cells (A=18, H=17 per glyph, 35 total); every primitive coordinate lies within its cell bounds (no out-of-grid)
C2 changing the setting varies ONLY the registered radius dimension; glyph masks (ON cells) and grid centers are IDENTICAL across s1/s2/s3
C3 deliberately bad case is detected: out_of_grid=True and/or unregistered_scale=True reported, not silently accepted

C4 small-size render: a 4px-cell render is emitted with 35 primitives retained; connectivity/counter (enclosed-hole) topology and readability are NOT measured (C4 checks only n_primitives); unmeasured / pending_human (no readability / loss claim)
C5 SVG and PNG outputs both exist and have declared dimensions (220x140 main, 60x40 small)
C6 deterministic rerun: full second generation; per-file sha256 identical
C7 BOUNDARY: do NOT label a full font, do NOT claim variable-font axes proven/disproven, do NOT claim the artist's geometry
boundaries: This is a hand-declared 2-glyph geometry toy. It does NOT equal a complete font, language coverage, or readability at production sizes.
The 15 negative barcode decodes from the earlier SEED lane are NOT re-run here; no encoding/payload read-back is attempted, so NO 'usable encoding' claim is made in either direction.
'未找到 fvar/font-axis 来源' does NOT prove the artist did NOT use a variable font; it remains 未证实/unverified.
Synthetic geometry is NOT author artwork; no E2/E3/active promotion. Seed stays E1 (5/30 full posts, 20/30 ID-only, 0 videos, X unavailable).
No image API, no font engine, no author files, no credentials, no ffmpeg/archive media.
